title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Cancellation, Reschedule and No-Access Schedule
content:
Each call class of Repair and Emergency Service Calls has its own notice period, cancellation and trip fees, free reschedules and reclassification setting. They are set out below.

| Call class | Notice for a free cancellation (elapsed hours before the window starts) | Late cancellation fee | Trip fee | On-site wait before no access is recorded | Free reschedules before dispatch | Move to a Standard Service Call allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | 24 hours | $0.00 (none) | $89.00 | 15 minutes | 2 | No |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | 2 hours | $49.00 | $119.00 | 15 minutes | 1 | Yes |
| Evening Service Call | 2 hours | $49.00 | $129.00 | 15 minutes | 1 | Yes |
| Weekend Service Call | 12 hours | $49.00 | $129.00 | 15 minutes | 2 | Yes |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | 0 hours | $0.00 (none) | $189.00 | 15 minutes | 0 | Yes |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | 0 hours | $0.00 (none) | $249.00 | 15 minutes | 0 | Yes |

## What each column means

- **Notice for a free cancellation**: the elapsed hours before the start of the arrival window by which the call can be cancelled without a fee.
- **Late cancellation fee**: charged when the call is cancelled with less notice but before dispatch. $0.00 means no such fee in that class.
- **Trip fee**: charged when the call is cancelled after dispatch or the technician cannot get access.
- **On-site wait**: the minutes the technician waits on site before recording no access.
- **Free reschedules**: the reschedules allowed without a fee before dispatch when made with the required notice.
- **Move to a Standard Service Call allowed**: whether a booking in the class may be moved to a Standard Service Call at the customer's request before dispatch.

## Worked readings (hypothetical windows)

- A Weekend Service Call with a 12:00-17:00 window on Saturday: a request at 23:30 on Friday gives 12.5 hours of notice, at least 12; a request at 00:30 on Saturday gives 11.5 hours, less than 12.
- A Same-Day Priority Service Call with an 08:00-12:00 window has a 2-hour notice period, so the free cancellation period closes at 06:00 that morning.
